title: LoGIC: Budgeted Context Construction for Node-Level Graph In-Context Learning with Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.05955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models have become powerful graph learners. Systems such as G2T-FM and GraphPFN encode each node as a feature row and make predictions through in-context learning (ICL), with labeled rows serving as the prompt. Current protocols employ the complete training table as context, causing attention to scale quadratically with the labeled pool and introducing preprocessing and memory bottlenecks. We investigate context construction for node-level graph ICL: which labeled nodes and auxiliary unlabeled nodes should constitute the prompt for specified queries. We formulate this allocation in terms of two resources: a labeled-context budget for predictive evidence and an unlabeled-halo budget for adapter message passing without using label capacity. translated_title: LoGIC：基于预算的上下文构建用于表格基础模型的节点级图上下文学习
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型已成为强大的图学习器。诸如G2T-FM和GraphPFN等系统将每个节点编码为特征行，并通过上下文学习（ICL）进行预测，其中带标签的行作为提示。当前的协议使用完整的训练表作为上下文，导致注意力随带标签池的规模呈二次方增长，并引入了预处理和内存瓶颈。我们研究节点级图ICL的上下文构建问题：哪些带标签节点和辅助的无标签节点应该构成指定查询的提示。我们从两种资源的角度来表述这种分配：用于预测证据的带标签上下文预算，以及用于适配器消息传递且不占用标签容量的无标签光环预算。我们提出了LoGIC，它通过结构、特征和覆盖三种通道检索带标签节点，在图局部聚类内的查询之间共享上下文，并结合…
tldr: 提出LoGIC方法，通过在带标签上下文预算和无标签光环预算下检索并跨查询共享上下文，解决了节点级图上下文学习中注意力随带标签池二次方增长导致的预处理和内存瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: LoGIC addresses the quadratic attention scaling and memory bottlenecks in node-level graph in-context learning by constructing budgeted contexts—retrieving labeled nodes through structural, feature-based, and coverage channels and sharing contexts across graph-local query clusters.
